PC: Requests additional history (e.g., prior Emergency Department course and exam).
Performs or delegates ventilator troubleshooting and endotracheal tube inspection.
When apneic, the patient is extubated (potentially over a Bougie).
When unable to mask ventilate, reintubation via various maneuvers.
If unable to intubate, surgical airway is pursued.
MK: Identifies significant air leak in the ventilator system and dislodged tube.
SBP: Requests anesthesiologist assistance and bronchoscope (which will be delayed).
